entries.name: Prismatic Observatory
entries.description: Reusable nested orbital instrument: nine gyroscopic rings, satellites, a crystal heart and a star field. Controls for motion, expansion, inclination and palette.

entries.name: Particle Tornado
entries.description: Blue particles and amber sparks with adjustable count, height, width, spin, turbulence, size and glow.

entries.name: Metallic Cube
entries.description: Reusable spinning metallic cube. Includes a shared cube primitive module with the fan's six-color metallic palette.

entries.name: Metallic Cube Fan
entries.description: The complete six-arm, 168-cube metallic cascade as a reusable image-source component. Uses the shared cube primitive, with spin, spread, cascade speed and size controls.

entries.name: Prismatic Cube Fan
entries.description: Reusable metallic cube spiral with 1–20 rainbow arms, palette shift, reversible lightness gradient and cube size taper. Preserves the original Metallic Cube Fan separately.

entries.name: Colorful Sweeping Beams
entries.description: Layered colorful beams with width, length, sweep speed, angle, pulse, brightness and palette controls.

entries.name: Dancing Space Needle Dabbers
entries.description: Fifty dancing Space Needle characters with dab depth, dance speed and vivid palette controls; beams saved separately.

entries.name: Wandering Tracers
entries.description: Ready-to-use tracer effect referencing the independent path generator and watercolor renderer.

entries.name: Wandering Tracer Paths
entries.description: Independent animated perimeter path generator. Outputs paths2d for drawing, region cuts, or other scene effects.

entries.name: Wandering Tracer Renderer
entries.description: Paints supplied paths2d over an input image with watercolor pigment, randomized hatching and fine outlines. Does not generate paths.

entries.name: Organic Regions
entries.description: Slowly flowing weighted regions with varied size and density. Supplies shader fragments and controls to a compatible painting renderer without an extra image pass.

entries.name: Region Hatching
entries.description: Region-specific curved, directional and perpendicular hatch patterns, with controlled irregularity and optional unhatched areas. Shader-field for compatible single-pass painting renderers.

entries.name: Animated Watercolor
entries.description: Slowly shifting blue-green washes and moving warm pools, with regional color contrast, pigment pooling and watercolor blooms. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.

entries.name: Organic Boundary Ink
entries.description: Uneven warm outlines, hand-drawn character and stationary paper grain. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.

entries.name: Composition Phrasing
entries.description: Shared artistic clock, slow tension and release, scale hierarchy, and the painting noise basis. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.

entries.name: Region Styles & Split Transitions
entries.description: Combines compatible organic-region, hatch, watercolor, boundary and phrasing fields into a painting. Shared paths carve daughter regions with smooth color and hatch-style transitions; connect a tracer renderer afterward for visible ink.
